As reflected in its title, the work systematically cross-correlates the dyad of material form (*rūpīduka*) with the triad concerning visible and reactive phenomena (*sanidassanattika*) through the conditional relational matrices typical of the Paṭṭhāna [Catalog; SuttaCentral].
